meta.title: Customers and CRM · Clafina
meta.description: One page per customer with what they bought, owe and said. Deals, support tickets, loyalty points and campaigns, all from the same record.

hero.title: Everything about a customer, on one page.
hero.lede: What they bought, what they owe and what they said, next to your deals, tickets, points and campaigns. It all comes from the documents you already make.

jobs.title: Follow up on deals
jobs.body: Keep deals on pipeline boards with the calls and visits that move them. You see which ones have stopped moving.

jobs.title: Answer support on time
jobs.body: Every ticket has a number, an owner and a due time. First replies and resolutions are timed, and late ones are escalated.

jobs.title: Bring customers back
jobs.body: Customers earn points and spend them on what they owe. Campaigns reach the people who said yes to hearing from you.

tour.title: Sell to a company, not just a person
tour.body: A company customer is billed under its legal name and tax numbers. Its people order for it, each within a limit you set.
points: Buyers, approvers and receivers, each with their own limit
Sites you deliver to, picked as Ship to on an invoice
Terms, credit limit and price group applied when you sell

tour.title: Know which customer is waiting
tour.body: Support tickets show what customers raised, who owns each one and how long it has waited for a reply.
points: First-reply and resolution times on every ticket
Service levels that escalate a ticket when it runs late
Each ticket linked to the invoice or order it is about

tour.title: Answer from your phone
tour.body: Read the customer's message, leave a note only the team sees and reply, wherever you are.

items.text: A page for every customer with what they owe and every document and payment between you.
Company customers with their legal identity, sites, buyers and buyer limits.
Lists, merging duplicates, and import and export by CSV.
Customer prices from price books, agreements, tiers and rebates.
Lists that keep themselves up to date as customers change.
Deals on pipeline boards, with the activities that move them.
Support tickets that are numbered, owned, due and linked to documents.
First-response and resolution times, and service levels that escalate.
Reminders sent for the follow-ups you plan.
A loyalty scheme with tiers and a points ledger. Points earned and spent are both in the books.
Gift cards issued by your staff.
Points that expire after a time you choose.
Campaigns by email, SMS, WhatsApp and in the app, with opens, clicks and conversions.
Saved audiences, consent records, a preference centre and one-click unsubscribe.
What each campaign cost, from the books, and what it costs to win a customer on each channel.

connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Every quotation, invoice and receipt shows on the customer's page.
Points earned and spent post to the ledger by themselves.
Customer messages and replies sit in the same inbox as the rest of your work.
The till finds the customer and adds or spends their points.
Shoppers see their points in their account.
Reports show what it costs to win a customer and what they are worth over time.

faq.q: Can a company customer have several people ordering for it?
faq.a: Yes. Add its buyers, approvers and receivers, each with the largest order they may place. Orders above a limit wait for an approver.

faq.q: Do loyalty points show in the books?
faq.a: Yes. Points earned and points spent both post to the ledger, so you always know what the points you have given out are worth.
Yes. Every marketing message carries a one-click unsubscribe, and people choose what they get in a preference centre. Their consent is kept on record.

cta.title: See your customers in one place.
cta.body: Start free, or book a demo and we will walk through a customer from first deal to repeat order.
